plan.title: bug(hooks,cli): lifecycle verbs still deny normal agent shells as not inspectable (regression class of #4577/#4780)

narratives.Description: As an agent or operator, I want lifecycle verbs to accept normal compound shells when my owner session-id matches, so that hatch and task -- recovery stop false not-inspectable denials without weakening fail-closed ownership.

3) CHANGELOG Unreleased activation note only on this PR.
